name: Ebonwake Citadel
difficulty_label: Expert — healers, reviving revenants, nests and transforming knights
description: Veyra’s abandoned citadel hangs above a black sea. Tight bridges connect the infirmary, rookery, chrysalis forge and final court. Finish revenants while fallen, interrupt transformations, and eliminate healers and nests before confronting the Last Creditor.
